description: This file defines classes and functions for handling keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen input events in a browser automation context, including key descriptions, modifier handling, and input simulation.

classes.name: Keyboard
classes.description: Handles keyboard input simulation, including key presses, releases, text insertion, and modifier management.

classes.name: Mouse
classes.description: Simulates mouse movements, clicks, and wheel actions.

methods.name: _keyDescriptionForString
methods.description: Retrieves key description for a given string, considering modifiers.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types a string, handling individual character input.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates pressing and releasing a key combination.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves mouse cursor to specified coordinates.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Performs mouse click with optional delay.
